posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: The biggest swing of the #BlueJays season. Kazuma Okamoto has put them up, 5-4, with a three-run shot. His 33rd of the season.

reply_texts.text: As long as the mismanager of the year doesn't rest all the guys capable of licking this down while parading the B team right into a loss.  Must win games in the last 2 weeks of the season, with two scheduled off days, isn't When you rest people.
reply_texts.author: ah-fars.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: It's Whisky o'clock while I watch the bull pen.
reply_texts.author: bikenwhisky.bsky.social

reply_texts.text: Don't worry, Schneider will figure out a way to screw it up.
reply_texts.author: flipout1.bsky.social

posts.jp: 岡本和真が3ラン本塁打で、ブルージェイズを5-4とリード。今季33号。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.text: Rico Garcia enters for a save situation. He inherits a 2-1 Orioles lead. Baltimore had runners on the corners with on out against Kodai Senga in the top of the frame, but Samuel Basallo and Dylan Beavers struck out.
posts.jp: リコ・ガルシアがセーブ場面で登板。オリオールズの2-1リードを継承。千賀滉大から両コーナーのランナーを出したが、2者連続三振に。

posts.author: Andy Kostka
posts.jp: ピート・アロンソへの追悼

posts.author: Keegan Matheson
posts.text: It’s stunning that, after all of this, the 75-76 #BlueJays still sit one game back of the Guardians for the final spot. The bar is… low. They’re getting all the help in the world here.
posts.jp: 75勝76敗のブルージェイズがガーディアンズから1ゲーム差という状況は驚き。水準は低い。あらゆるサポートを受けている。

posts.author: Jordan Bastian
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong continues to check some historic boxes down the stretch here: With his 2-run double in 2nd, Crow-Armstrong is first Cubs batter with 40+ homers and 100+ RBI since Derrek Lee in 2005. PCA is the first 40-100 Cub with 30+ steaks. Ryne Sandberg went 40-100 with 25 steals in 1990.
posts.jp: ピート・クロウ・アームストロングは歴史的な記録を更新中。2回の2ラン二塁打で、2005年のデレク・リー以来初のホーム40以上・打点100以上のカブス選手に。盗塁30以上は初。

posts.author: Jordan Bastian
posts.text: Pete Crow-Armstrong churned out another four hits tonight. Launched his 42nd homer of the year. Stole his 37th base. Collected RBI Nos. 99-102. His fWAR is up to an MLB-leading 10.1 on the season.
posts.jp: ピート・クロウ・アームストロングが今夜4安打。今季42号ホーマーを放つ。盗塁37個目。打点99～102番を記録。fWARはMLBトップの10.1に。

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Monday’s Guardians lineup vs. the White Sox: CF Kwan 3B Ramírez DH DeLauter RF Adell 2B Bazzana LF Martínez 1B Lowe C Bailey SS Rocchio SP Williams
posts.jp: 月曜日のガーディアンズ対ホワイトソックス先発オーダー：CF クワン 3B ラミレス DH デラウター RF アデル 2B バザーナ LF マルティネス 1B ロウ C ベイリー SS ロッキオ SP ウィリアムス

posts.author: Tim Stebbins
posts.text: Bases loaded with one out? Gavin Williams works in and out of trouble, and he was pumped up.
posts.jp: 満塁1アウト。ギャビン・ウィリアムスが窮地を切り抜け、テンションが上がった。
